title: cleome trachysperma
intro: Cleome trachysperma, commonly known as Spider Flower, is a flowering plant species native to tropical Asia. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Cleome trachysperma include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. Bioactive constituents found in Cleome trachysperma include flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, alkaloids like berberine and palmatine, and phenolic acids like ferulic acid and sinapic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
